company.name: Mahek Marketing India
company.tagline: Manufacturer of premium industrial thinners, solvents & specialty chemical products. Trusted by 1190+ customers across 8+ Indian states.

products.name: Mahek Universal Thinner
products.short: One Thinner for all your painting needs
description: Mahek Universal Thinner is a premium-grade, bloom-resistant thinner with a medium to fast-drying formulation that delivers excellent gloss and self-leveling finishes, making it highly versatile for use with enamel, acrylic, automotive paints, primers, lacquers, sanding sealer, as well as ideal for wood finishes, furniture polish, and automotive coatings.

products.name: Mahek NC Thinner
products.short: Precision Formulated for Perfect Flow & Finish.
description: Mahek N.C. Thinner is a specially formulated blend for reducing the viscosity of lacquer paints, wood polishes, and automotive coatings. It is quick-drying, low in odor, and ensures smooth consistency for uniform application. Ideal for enamel, acrylic, and lacquer-based systems, it helps achieve a bloom-resistant, self-leveling, and high-gloss finish for professional-grade results.
applications: Cleaning Spray Guns, Rollers, and Brushes

products.name: Mahek PU Thinner
products.short: Premium Polyurethane Thinner for Professional Finishes.
description: Mahek Polyurethane (P.U.) Thinner is a high-performance thinner formulated for the thinning of P.U. paints. It is ideal for solvent-based polyurethane sealers, primers, clear, melamine, and pigmented topcoats—ensuring superior paint consistency and smooth, glossy application.

products.name: Mahek Nano Thinner
description: Nano Thinner is designed for superior cleaning and thinning performance in paints and primers. It thins out oil-based paints & primers, easily cleans brushes, rollers, spray guns, pipes, and equipment, and is widely used across paint, hardware, and industrial applications. With fast-drying, low odor, and eco-conscious formulation, Nano Thinner ensures superior results at competitive pricing.
applications: Cleaning Spray Guns, Rollers, and Brushes

products.name: Mylac-135 Melamine Thinner
products.short: Delivers smooth flow, excellent leveling, and lasting gloss at cost-effective pricing.
description: MYLAC-135 Melamine Thinner is a premium solvent-based reducing agent designed to provide ideal viscosity for melamine paints and polishes.It ensures uniform flow, excellent leveling, and a deep mirror-like gloss, giving furniture and coatings a flawless, durable finish. Known for its consistency, clarity, and low residue, MYLAC-135 combines performance and affordability trusted by professional applicators across India.

products.name: Mahek Epoxy Thinner
description: Mahek Epoxy Thinner is a carefully formulated solvent blend designed to thin epoxy paints and clean application tools. It ensures perfect film thickness, reduces orange peel, and minimizes dry spots or spray dust. With a fast-drying, bloom-resistant, high-gloss, and self-leveling formulation, it delivers consistent performance for epoxy-based primers and coatings.

products.name: Mahek Polish Thinner M1433
description: The Mahek M-1433 Thinner is specially formulated for removing sealants, oil, grease, wax, and paint residues. It provides powerful cleaning and degreasing, evaporates quickly without residue, and is widely used across furniture, paint, and retail industries for achieving smooth, residue-free finishes.
applications: Cleaning Spray Guns, Rollers, and Brushes

products.name: Mahek Mild Cleaner M164
products.short: Bringing Natural Beauty Back to Wood & Metal.
description: Mahek M-164 Thinner is a ready-to-use mild cleaner that restores the natural appearance of weathered, gray, and dirty decks. It effectively removes mildew, algae, and fungus stains, providing deep cleaning for outdoor wood, furniture, and composite decks.
benefits: Removes mildew, algae, and fungus stains
Deep cleaning for outdoor wood, furniture

products.name: Mahek Enamel / G.P. Thinner
products.short: Rich Oil-Base Reducing Agent for Premium Enamel & Oil Paint Systems
description: Mahek Enamel Thinner (MTO Base) is a premium oil-based reducing agent specially formulated to provide the required viscosity for enamel and oil paints. It ensures smooth flow, uniform film formation, and a rich high-gloss finish. Designed for both thinning and cleaning applications, it effectively reduces paint thickness while maintaining surface quality. Ideal for industrial, hardware, and decorative paint applications, Mahek Enamel Thinner delivers consistent performance at cost-effective pricing.
applications: Cleaning Spray Guns, Rollers, and Brushes

milestones.title: Foundation of the Company
milestones.description: Melody Chemical was established by Bipin Doshi in Bhandup, Mumbai, with a focus on manufacturing thinners and solvents in bulk quantities. This marked the beginning of our journey in the chemical manufacturing industry.

milestones.title: Building Our Product Portfolio
milestones.description: Mahek Marketing was established, with the business shifting its operations to Bhiwandi. As customer requirements evolved, we expanded beyond a single product and developed a broader portfolio for diverse applications across the paint, coating, and industrial markets. Our portfolio grew to include products such as Mahek Universal Thinner, Mahek NC Thinner, Mahek PU Thinner, Mahek Nano Thinner, and specialty solvent products.

milestones.title: Reassessing & Planning for Growth
milestones.description: The COVID-19 pandemic highlighted key areas where the business needed to evolve. We undertook a detailed review of our operations, identified areas for improvement, and strengthened our business policies and processes. This period also marked the development of clear growth goals and a focused roadmap for the future.

milestones.title: Ambernath MIDC Manufacturing Expansion
milestones.description: The development of our manufacturing facility at Ambernath MIDC, Maharashtra, marked an important stage in our growth. It strengthened our control over production, quality, batch consistency, packaging and supply planning.

milestones.title: Growing Our Customer Network
milestones.description: Our growth has been driven by the relationships we built with paint dealers, distributors, industrial customers, painters, contractors and retailers. Our customer network grew to 850+ customers, reflecting the trust placed in our products and service.

milestones.title: Expanding Across India
milestones.description: We expanded beyond our original market and established a presence across 8+ states in India. Our focus evolved from simply selling products to building a stronger and more structured distribution network for long-term national growth.

milestones.title: Product & Market Innovation
milestones.description: As customer requirements continued to evolve, we began focusing more strongly on specialty applications and new product opportunities, including solutions for industrial and adhesive-related applications. Our approach remains focused on identifying real customer requirements and developing practical product solutions around them.

milestones.title: Building the Next Generation of Mahek
milestones.description: We are strengthening manufacturing, sales, technology, customer engagement, distribution and product development to prepare Mahek Marketing India for the next stage of structured growth.

about.hero.title: About Mahek Marketing India
about.hero.description: 30+ years of manufacturing discipline behind every material we dispatch.
about.story.title: From a small blending unit to a nationwide manufacturer
about.story.paragraph1: Mahek Marketing India began as a small thinner blending operation in Mumbai, built on a simple premise: dealers and industrial buyers deserve consistent quality at a fair price, every single time.
about.story.paragraph2: Today, our Ambernath MIDC facility manufactures 15 tons of industrial thinners and specialty solvents daily, serving 1190+ customers across more than 8 Indian states — without ever compromising on the batch-to-batch consistency that built our reputation.
about.mission.title: Our Mission
about.mission.text: Our mission is to deliver high-quality products and continuously introduce new offerings under our white-label brand. We are building a strong national presence with regional depots across East, West, North, South, and Central India. Through excellent service, transparency, and a customer-first approach, we aim to ensure satisfaction and foster long-term relationships with every customer we serve.
about.vision.title: Our Vision
about.vision.text: Our vision is to become the top leader and the largest supply chain partner in India’s For paints and coatings industry — supported by a strong nationwide network of salesmen, dealers, and distributors. We are committed to making Mahek Marketing India’s products available in every district of the country, for a lifetime, by offering great value, innovative solutions, and building a ₹10,000 crore business through trusted, long-term relationships.
